frozen_source_bytes.scope: Byte identity only; not a fresh gate or final-bundle acceptance.

inputs.hashing: Full SHA-256 of every named file, including all 11 complete databases. File size/mtime/device/inode checked again after all computations.

topic_inventory.scope: Exactly the 11 named raw bags; no universal claim about unavailable files.
topic_inventory.positive_control: Nonzero clouds in every bag; nonzero MarkerArray and rosout in same query.
topic_inventory.excluded: The previously observed malformed ride-spool/new_data_215.db3 is not queried; no absence claim is made about that split.

direct_validation.method: Recomputed from saved matrices; no registration was run. Ordered failures are recomputed conditions, not a newly captured execution trace.
direct_validation.limits: Closure/seed agreement is not an independently calibrated absolute pose bound; station labels are nominal selections from rejected trajectories.

landmark_validation.limits: These are combined association/centroid/pose errors, not a measured pure pose-error distribution. Raw observations are not deskewed. Shared-track absence applies only to the retained tracks and 24 specified pairs.

raw_checks.interpretation: The raw reflector supports the longitudinal 1.34 m mode, not full SE3 truth. Slices count returns, not rail heads. Wider Z changes support, not rail identity.
raw_checks.corrected_preflight: The earlier independent finite-only crop was incorrect; the decoder now reproduces the inclusive 2.5 <= range <= 250 m crop and checks all four raw frames.

historical_a_axis.provenance: Archived merged H1 probe, measured 0f02b28; historical retained E evidence at 7d0f571. NOT a measurement of current HEAD.
historical_a_axis.limits: Axis-aligned injection is not independent rail truth; no causal labels or new wrong-selected-pair/no-rails acceptance are inferred.

prior_independent_crosscheck.method: Before this script existed, independent SSH reads used raw SQLite GROUP BY and metadata, raw CDR decoding, rotation-trace matrix checks and direct withheld-observation residuals. This run additionally compares portable archive members byte-for-byte to those retained inputs.

minimal_missing_input: Independently checked left/right rail-head geometry in identified A/C frames at 100-150 m, with support, correct path identity and quantified uncertainty; or synchronized independently validated relative SE3 poses/extrinsics/error budget plus independently checked later near-rail observations. Reconstruction is not surveyed truth.

alternatives.new_method: Explicit fixed physical corner/joint correspondences, closed-form rigid solve (not ICP), >=3 non-collinear anchors plus excluded independent anchors, conditioning, acquisition-time and measurement-error checks before transferring near rails.
alternatives.current_feasibility: Retained features do not supply a full-pose anchor set in the 24 specified nominal far pairs. This does not prove all manual raw-data methods impossible.

limits: No detector replay, instrumentation, production import, optimization, release action or held-out run.
The reported 63 misses are historical archived results, not fresh current-main findings.
Wrong-selected-pair and current replay are outside this review; no acceptance is inferred.
Live public listing and archive-inventory checks from the preceding read-only session are documented in README, not claimed to have been repeated by this offline script.
